prompt: A low-poly 3D floating island: a small chunk of land built from faceted, flat-shaded polygons with crisp edges, its rocky underside tapering to a point, hovering in empty space. On the island: A warm brick patio floor holds a long wooden dining table crowded with red bowls of pasta, wine glasses, and bread baskets. Overhead, crisscrossed string lights glow with soft amber light. At the center of the table sits an oversized square tiramisu glowing beneath a fizzing golden sparkler. A figure in a yellow dress sits beside it, while a waiter in a white shirt and dark apron leans in from the left holding the dessert platter. Two friends sit opposite in teal and olive sweaters. Clean stylized game-asset look: every element, including people, furniture, food and plants, is built from flat-shaded faceted polygons in soft pastel colors, with no realistic textures. The whole world is one compact object, centered, filling about two thirds of the frame with empty space on every side, seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above. Nothing extends beyond its edges: no horizon, sky or distant scenery behind it. Plain seamless pale gray background with nothing else in it. Soft, even, diffuse light with only a gentle contact shadow; everything in crisp focus. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos anywhere.
